newsitem.title: USA: Penske Motorsports in pact with speedway.
newsitem.headline: Penske Motorsports in pact with speedway.

text.p: Penske Motorsports Inc. said Tuesday it executed a merger agreement with North Carolina Motor Speedway Inc following an approval of the deal by the speedway's board of directors.
The deal will be submitted to the speedway's shareholders for approval at a meeting in September, Penske said. Penske acquired a 70 percent interest in the speedway in May.
Further details about the transaction were not immediately available.
